label: SUCCESSOR_CLOSED_DESIGNATION_POLICY_3: Every successor of every admitted actuality choice is…
definition: Every successor of every admitted actuality choice is another admitted actuality choice, on one fixed frame and ontology. Admission is a semantic restriction, not existence of a world in reality. Empty admission is allowed.
note: Analyst formulation for issue #1049. Neither naming/context policy nor metaphysical applicability is defended. SEP Modal Logic §§10/16 is navigation only; attribution deferred. No new modal calculus or reality claim.
